body: U+0023 2026-10-08: spec written for Windows and the release pipelineU+000AU+000AThe owner asked for Windows as a third platform that looks and works like macOS with no regressions, plus a GitHub release pipeline on tags. The instruction was to work autonomously with no questions, spec with interphase, dispatch with mitosis, and end with draft PRs. Approval of the spec is the owner's delegation, recorded in the decisions file.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Grounding.**U+000AU+002D The checkout's main is 164 commits behind origin/main (65bbbe27). Grounding used a git-archive snapshot of origin/main in the session scratchpad.U+000AU+002D About a dozen Dart checks read macOS to mean desktop.U+000AU+002D Seven Dart channels are answered natively only by macos/Runner: window, notification_settings, device_storage, camera_settings, spellcheck, pasteboard and file_drop.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Plugin research** (cited researcher run):U+000AU+002D Windows renders with Impeller on OpenGL ES via ANGLE.U+000AU+002D video_player needs video_player_win 3.3.0 or later; just_audio needs just_audio_windows.U+000AU+002D camera_windows is not endorsed, cannot pause, and writes into the user's Videos and Pictures folders.U+000AU+002D flutter_local_notifications throws without Windows init settings and has no permission API.U+000AU+002D path_provider's documents folder on Windows is the user's Documents.U+000AU+002D windows-latest has Inno Setup 6.7.1 and ATL.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Spec and Steps.**U+000AU+002D Spec: 27 criteria (3 unproven: 7.25, 7.26, 7.27) and 13 Steps.U+000AU+002D Three stacked MSPs, in this order:U+000A  1U+002E windows-desktop: Dart only.U+000A  2U+002E windows-runner: the windows/ folder plus native bridges.U+000A  3U+002E release-pipeline: release.yml, Inno Setup script, DMG script and Android release signing.U+000AU+002D Release is last so its PR build compiles the whole stack on windows-latest and yields the installer for the VM check.U+000AU+002D mitosis plan-only: 11 lanes, up to 5 in parallel, no coupling or stacking warnings.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Base branch.** mitosis/windows-release-base was created at origin/main.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Pending.**U+000AU+002D A spec-reviewer pass.U+000AU+002D A prepared patch to the native tasks: Flutter's runner builds with /W4 /WX and _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0, so it uses WRL rather than C++/WinRT for the toast setting, and SC_MOVE/SC_SIZE system commands for drag and top resize.
